name: FARSTALKER KINBAND
description: Farstalker Kinbands operate as scouts for the Kroot species. They range far and wide throughout the galaxy, seeking new and valuable genetic material to return to their Shapers. Farstalker Kinbands contain expert trackers, hunters and guerrilla fighters who are capable of matching far more technologically advanced foes.

selection.operatives:
*↘* 1 FARSTALKER KINBAND KILL-BROKER operative with one of the following options:
 ○ Kroot rifle; ritual blade
 ○ Pulse weapon; ritual blade
*↘* 11 FARSTALKER KINBAND operatives selected from the following list:
 * BOW-HUNTER
 * COLD-BLOOD
 * CUT-SKIN
 * HOUND
 * LONG-SIGHT
 * PISTOLIER
 * STALKER
 * TRACKER
 * HEAVY GUNNER with one of the following options:
 ○ Dvorgite skinner; blade
 ○ Londaxi tribalest; blade
 * WARRIOR with one of the following options:
 ○ Kroot rifle; blade
 ○ Kroot scattergun; blade
Other than HOUND and WARRIOR operatives, your kill team can only include each operative on this list once. Your kill team can only include up to two HOUND operatives.

operatives.name: KROOT KILL-BROKER
operatives.description: Farstalker Kinbands are led by Kill-brokers. These Kroot are not only expert tacticians and skilled fighters, but also able negotiators, ensuring their kin receive just rewards for their services.

abilities.name: Victory Shriek
abilities.rules: Whenever your mark is incapacitated, you can select one friendly FARSTALKER KINBAND  operative within 6" of this operative. Until the end of the battle, that operative’s weapons have the Balanced weapon rule. Each friendly operative can only be selected for this rule once per battle.

abilities.name: VENGEANCE FOR THE KINBAND
abilities.rules: If all kroot models are incapaciteted(excluding kroot hound model) this model now has the relentless weapon rule on all of its weapons for the rest of the game

operatives.name: KROOT BOW-HUNTER
operatives.description: The accelerator bows wielded by these Kroot are distinctive weapons, with a Kroot rifle at their core. When fired, the bow’s curves crackle with energy, charging the loaded arrow’s head. Effects on struck enemies vary depending on the material the arrowhead is made from.

abilities.name: ENERGISE
abilities.rules: Until the end of the turning point or until this operative has shot with its accelerator bow (whichever comes first), all profiles of its accelerator bow have the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.rules: This operative cannot perform any actions other than Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Gather, Guard, Reposition, Pick Up Marker and Place Marker. It cannot use any weapons that aren’t on its datacard.

abilities.name: BAD TEMPERED
abilities.rules:
Whenever an enemy operative performs the Fight action, if
this operative is a valid operative to fight against, you can force them to select
this operative to fight against instead. Whenever an enemy operative ends
the Charge action within control range of another friendly FARSTALKER
KINBAND operative within 3" of this operative, if this operative isn’t
within control range of enemy operatives, this operative can immediately
perform a free Charge action, but must end that move within control range
of that enemy operative.

actions.name: GATHER
actions.rules: Perform a free Dash or Reposition action with this operative. During that move, you can perform a free Pick Up Marker or Place Marker action with this operative (you can determine control during that action to do so), and any remaining move distance it had from the Dash or Reposition action can be used after it does so.
effects:
Perform a free Dash or Reposition action with this operative. During
that move, you can perform a free Pick Up Marker or Place Marker
action with this operative (you can determine control during that action
to do so), and any remaining move distance it had from the Dash or
Reposition action can be used after it does so.

actions.name: LONG-SIGHT
effects:
Until the start of this operative’s next activation:
• The concealed and stationary profiles of its Kroot hunting rifle have the
Lethal 5+ weapon rule.
• Whenever it’s shooting with its Kroot hunting rifle, enemy operatives cannot
be obscured.
conditions:
This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an
enemy operative.

operatives.name: MB3 RECON DRONE
operatives.keywords: PATHFINDER , T'AU EMPIRE, MB3 RECON, DRONE

abilities.name: DRONE
abilities.rules:
• This operative cannot perform any actions other than Charge, Dash, Fall
Back, Fight, Markerlight, Reposition and Shoot. It cannot use any
weapons that aren’t on its datacard.
• Whenever determining control of an objective marker, treat this operative’s
APL stat as 1 lower.
• Whenever determining what’s visible to this operative, the round disc at the
top of the miniature is its head.

operatives.name: XV26 NEUTRALISER
operatives.keywords: XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT , T'AU EMPIRE, NEUTRALISER

abilities.name: MULTISPECTRUM SENSOR PACKAGE: SUPPORT.
abilities.rules:

point, when an enemy operative visible to and within 8" of this
operative is activated, you can use this rule. If you do, each
friendly  operative within 3" of this operative can immediately do one of the following:
• Perform a free Dash action (in an order of your choice).
• Change its order.
Each friendly operative that performs the Dash action cannot
end that move within 3" of an enemy operative. Note that a
Comms Device from universal equipment only affects the second
distance of this rule.

actions.name: SYSTEM JAM
effects:
Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until the
end of that operative’s next activation, subtract 1 from its
APL stat. Whenever this operative has a Conceal order, you
must spend 1 additional AP to perform this action.
conditions:
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

abilities.name: ART OF WAR
abilities.rules:
Once per battle STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one of the
following and apply its rules until the end of the turning point:
• Mont’ka: Add 1" to the Move stat of friendly PATHFINDER operatives.
• Kauyon: Friendly PATHFINDER operatives can perform a free
Markerlight action during their activation if they have a Conceal order.

abilities.name: DRONE CONTROLLER:
abilities.rules:
Whenever this operative is in the killzone:
• Add 2" to the Move stat of friendly PATHFINDER DRONE operatives.
• The Saviour Protocols firefight ploy costs you 0CP.

actions.name: REMOTE PILOT
effects:
One friendly PATHFINDER DRONE operative can immediately
perform one free action, but it cannot move more than 2" during that
action. That action can be one that’s normally restricted by its drone rule
(this takes precedence over that rule)
conditions:
This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an
enemy operative. This operative can perform this action more than once
during its activation, but if it does, the same DRONE operative cannot
perform the same free action more than once per activation.

abilities.name: GRENADIER SPECIALIST
abilities.rules:
This operative can use frag and krak grenades (see
universal equipment). Doing so doesn’t count towards any limited uses
you have (i.e. if you also select those grenades from equipment for other
operatives). Whenever it’s doing so, improve the Hit stat of that weapon by 1.

rules.name: FARSTALKER
rules.description: Farstalker Kindbands move and fight instinctively, reacting to developing battlefield conditions with an inhuman speed of thought.
rules.rules:
In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, you can change the order of up to three friendly FARSTALKER KINBAND  operatives that are not within control range of enemy operatives.
Whenever it’s your turn to counteract, you can change the order of one friendly FARSTALKER KINBAND  operative that’s not within control range of enemy operatives instead. This still counts as you counteracting (so activation alternates back to your opponent afterwards), but doesn’t count as that friendly operative’s counteraction for this turning point.

rules.name: THE EMPIRES ENEMY
rules.description: You choose one enemy operative at the start of the strategy faze and every friendly model gets the ceasless keyword against it.When the selected operative dies choose another target
